objs.name: document
objs.description: Core managed item created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, reactivated, and translated.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation, such as the type abbreviation and consecutive number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in its lifecycle or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope maintained as metadata and printed through TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an archived document is retained.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification on next release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement workflow on next release.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, validity periods, and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable for a document type when creating new document objects.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System or process role such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or business admin.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned for authorizations, reader access, archive access, business administration, or distribution.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document automatically released with the main document and versioned through the main release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information added to a document and released or published directly without the main release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for changes to an existing document.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document whose validity is approaching expiry.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups maintained for document distribution and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation that a distributed document has been acknowledged.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document for language-dependent display.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit object to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data object to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: IT application maintained as metadata and referenced by documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search result generated for documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type during document creation.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a template for the new document object.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata in categories.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content through the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the edited document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group- or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an additional information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly through switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly through switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process for a document.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes the release step and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject a document during review or release and cancel the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is revised or affected by attachment changes.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the valid until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive an invalidated document by revoking authorizations except archive group access.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation and create a new version of the invalidated document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain users and user groups on the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned groups by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement from distribution recipients by email on release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version so it is visible to authorized readers in the login language.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Generate role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Inform users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, override, release, or acknowledgement.
